name: Bar Rescue
description: Jon Taffer is the Gordon Ramsay of the bar and nightclub business. In each episode, Taffer helps transform a struggling bar into a vibrant, profitable business, utilizing his expertise as a nightlife consultant

videos.title: The Lost Episode
videos.overview: In this special 'lost' episode, Taffer takes on a hot-tempered New Jersey bar owner who can't stop kicking customers and employees out of his bar. Originally filmed in June of 2010, this episode was the pilot of the series.

videos.title: Taffer's Top 10: Worst Owners
videos.overview: Nightlife expert Jon Taffer counts down the ten worst owners he's encountered from the first three seasons of Bar Rescue.

videos.title: Taffer's Top 10: Most Disgusting Bars
videos.overview: Nightlife expert Jon Taffer counts down the ten most disgusting bars he's encountered from the first three seasons of Bar Rescue.

videos.title: Taffer's Top 10: Angriest Moments
videos.overview: Nightlife expert Jon Taffer counts down his ten angriest moments from the first three seasons of Bar Rescue.

videos.title: Taffer's Top 10: Toughest Rescues
videos.overview: Nightlife expert Jon Taffer counts down his ten toughest rescues from the first three seasons of Bar Rescue.

videos.title: Fallen Angels
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer attempts to class up Angels, a failing biker bar in Corona, California. To do that, he’ll have to transform their rowdy clientele, scantily-clad bikini bartenders and strip club persona.

videos.title: Downey's and Out
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer attempts to resuscitate Downey’s, a failing Irish pub in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. To do that, he’ll have to inspire Dom, a one-time star chef turned negligent owner, who has let the bar go to ruin.

videos.title: Shabby Abbey
videos.overview: Legendary Chicago music venue The Abbey Pub is a family-owned bar on its last legs. When bar expert Jon Taffer tries to return the pub to its original glory, he discovers that two of the sibling managers don’t see eye-to-eye.

videos.title: Beach Bummer
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer is called to Redondo Beach, CA, to save Kilkenny’s, an Irish pub on the decline. Though bar manager Carlos threatens Jon’s method and the pub’s success, owner Allie refuses to fire him.

videos.title: Swanky Troubles
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer attempts to breathe new life into failing Philadelphia champagne bar Swanky Bubbles. To accomplish that, he'll need to deal with a playboy owner, a sprawling menu, and the worst bar layout in America.

videos.title: The Blue Frog Sings the Blues
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer attempts to get The Blue Frog 22, a failing bar in Chicago, to grow up. To do that, he'll need the mother-and-son owners, Mimi and John, to ditch the "Mom's Basement" aesthetic that's dragging them down.

videos.title: Bad to the Bone
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer heads to Boston to help Bill, the owner of The Chicken Bone, avoid financial ruin. Bill, a former customer who took over the Bone, learned the hard way that running a bar is much tougher than it looks.

videos.title: Chumps
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer attempts to take Champs, a dated sports bar in Burbank, CA out of retirement. To do that, he’ll need owner Joe to go on the offensive, and take control of his over-pouring bartenders.

videos.title: Bar Fight
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer goes toe-to-toe with a former baseball player turned bar owner as he tries to revive the Canyon Inn, a decaying bar on its last legs.

videos.title: Hogtied Ham's
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer attempts to save automotive-themed Angry Ham’s Garage from stalling out. Rowdy owners and stonewalling city officials are all lurking right under the hood.

videos.title: Yo-Ho-Ho and a Bottle of Dumb
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer must patch holes in a sinking Pirate-themed bar in Silver Spring, MD. But mutiny is in the air when Jon forces the pirate staff to cater to the city's corporate clientele.

videos.title: Tiki Curse
videos.overview: Located on a prime stretch of beach, The Bamboo Beach Tiki Bar is still failing. Can Bar Expert Jon Taffer get a bevy of beautiful barmaids to fix this oceanfront eyesore instead of working on their suntans?

videos.title: Murphy's Mess
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer must fix a dirty, binge-drinking bar owned by two fraternity brothers in Fells Point, Maryland. But the rescue gets derailed when Jon discovers the building is about to collapse.

videos.title: Mystique or Murder?
videos.overview: Mystique Lounge in West Palm Beach, Florida, has operated under the shadow of a murder for three years. Can bar expert Jon Taffer restore a positive mystique to this once-cursed venue?

videos.title: Bottomless Pit
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer has his hands full with a failing dive bar in Orange, CA. When he discovers the owner is incapable of running the bar, Jon must pin his hopes on the owner’s untested but eager daughter.

videos.title: Broke Black Sheep
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer is called in to save the family-run Black Sheep in the Irish-German community of Cheviot, Ohio. But Jon discovers that the bar may be beyond rescue due to the owners’ massive debt.

videos.title: Weber's of Lies
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer must make a former strip club turned music venue profitable. But when the bar’s staff is found to be contributing to the financial problems, Jon must convince the owner to take a stand.

videos.title: Owner Ousted
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer must rescue a bar owned by a former Naval Officer from total ruin. But when Jon discovers one of the owners isn’t pulling his weight, Jon shows him the door.

videos.title: On the Rocks
videos.overview: Bar expert Jon Taffer must save a failing former smoker’s haven in Laguna Niguel, California from burning out for good. However, the bar’s gang of hard-drinking regulars aren’t about to give up...

videos.title: Bikini Bust
videos.overview: Despite beautiful bikini-clad bartenders, Extremes is less than a month from closing its doors.

videos.title: Turtle on Its Back
videos.overview: For a bar to fail on Bourbon Street in New Orleans it takes a special kind of incompetence.

videos.title: Rock N Roaches
videos.overview: Jon Taffer descends on a grotesque goth and rock bar in Austin, TX. Tasteless performances and cockroach infestations are the least of his problems as he spars with the worst bar owner to date.

videos.title: Bro's Got to Geaux!
videos.overview: Jon schools the owner of a beat-up college bar with a reputation for serving underage drinkers.

videos.title: Tears for Beers
videos.overview: A too-hip-for-its-own-good bar in Austin may need a hip replacement if it is to survive.

videos.title: Empty Pockets
videos.overview: A Denver pool hall owned by a proud immigrant gets help.

videos.title: Jon T, He Don't Like It
videos.overview: The formerly rocking Kasbah Lounge in Aurora, Colorado, which has fallen on hard times, is made over.

videos.title: In a Pinch
videos.overview: The locals are up in arms over a controversial lobster-tank game at a blue-collar watering hole.

videos.title: Karaoke Katastrophe
videos.overview: Jon makes over one of the country's first karaoke bars, dealing with outdated decor, a hot-under-the-collar chef and an owner who's oblivious to what's going on in his place, and a hoarder to boot.

videos.title: A Horse Walks Into a Bar
videos.overview: Horses defecating inside this Arizona bar are the least of Jon Taffer’s problems. He must contend with drunk owners, a family in turmoil, and a bank foreclosure if he hopes to save this business.

videos.title: Meat Sauna
videos.overview: Bad ventilation cause hot, moist burger smoke to fill Scottsdale’s least funny comedy club. Jon Taffer arrives to clear the air and use proven bar techniques to create bigger laughs and bigger profits for the troubled owners

videos.title: Don't Mess With Taffer's Wife
videos.overview: An aggressive Las Vegas bar owner tries to pick up Nicole Taffer, sending Jon into a rage. Can he set this owner’s wandering eyes straight and save a once famous blues bar without coming to blows first?

videos.title: Don't Judge a Booze by its Bottle
videos.overview: North Carolina’s Cashmere Nightclub has a bad name, poor décor and an embarrassing manager, but when Jon learns that they are refilling premium liquor bottles with cheap booze, all hell breaks loose.

videos.title: Two Flew Over the Handlebars
videos.overview: Two buxom sisters have driven their biker bar in Pawcatuck, Connecticut into a ditch. Can Jon get these party women to stop binge drinking and focus on the real assets of their bar?

videos.title: There's No Crying in the Bar Business
videos.overview: Jon heads to a Georgia sports bar and encounters an owner who’s incessant crying seems to prevent her noticing the massive employee theft issue occurring right under her nose.

videos.title: Play Some Janet Jackson!
videos.overview: Las Vegas' first gay nightclub, Gipsy, is months from closing its doors thanks to its verbally abusive and over intoxicated owner.

videos.title: Characters Assassination
videos.overview: A poor concept is among the problems hampering a North Carolina bar run by a family of Yankees.

videos.title: Corking the Bunghole
videos.overview: 13 miles from Fort Bragg, Cliques suffers from a juvenile name and a repugnant reputation. Jon puts a bar's owners through a personal bar boot camp to attract the local military personnel.

videos.title: A Bar Full of Bull
videos.overview: Jon tries to help two siblings from wasting their father's retirement with a rickety mechanical bull in a New England bar.

videos.title: Beer and Loathing in Las Vegas
videos.overview: Jon visits a struggling blue-collar joint in Las Vegas, where he deals with the strained friendship between the two classically trained chefs who own and operate it.

videos.title: Barely Above Water
videos.overview: Taffer makes two bars out of one in an attempt to save both a beachfront bar in Warwick, Rhode Island, and the owner’s marriage.

videos.title: Crappy Cantina
videos.overview: Jon steps in to help two brothers whose ill-conceived idea for a death-metal concert bar has drained their parents' retirement fund.

videos.title: Jon of the Dead
videos.overview: Jon has a few shocks to deliver to two former members of the music industry who have opened a horror-themed bar that is dying on its feet.

videos.title: Grandpa Got Run Over by His Grandkids
videos.overview: Jon tries to turn around a Las Vegas establishment owned by a man whose family is wasting his money.

videos.title: Hurricane Jon vs Hurricane Sandy
videos.overview: Jon races to repair the battered Bungalow Bar in Rockaway Beach after it felt the full force of Hurricane Sandy.

videos.title: Drunk & Dirty Dolls
videos.overview: After a near-fatal heart attack, Artie, the owner of Alibi in Las Vegas, lost his zeal for the work, and it's up to Jon to help him get it back.

videos.title: Empty Bottles Full Cans
videos.overview: Customers bringing in their own booze and bartenders flashing their boobs aren’t Jon’s biggest problems with this Tennessee watering hole. Taffer must ignite a lazy owner’s ingenuity to save the bar from going bust.

videos.title: Hole in None
videos.overview: This golf-themed bar is a swing and a miss and its horrendous sanitary conditions are completely out of bounds. Jon must clean house and get rid of the filth as well as the staff responsible for making his expert sick.

videos.title: Music City Mess
videos.overview:
Jon attempts to turn around a Nashville bar with a dated concept.

Note: The episode was originally supposed to air on November 24, 2013, but was replaced with an encore after the owner was involved in a fatal shooting.

videos.title: Brawlin Babes
videos.overview: A sports bar with no TV's isn't Jon's biggest problem at this Missouri establishment. Taffer must get brawling buckle bunny bartenders and their spineless owner to unite in one common cause: Gut the competition!

videos.title: Twin vs. Twin
videos.overview: Lights, sirens and handcuffs greet Jon before he even enters the door of this Kansas City bar. Sibling rivalry between two identical twins with identical huge egos present Taffer with one of his toughest rescues.

videos.title: Hostile Takeover
videos.overview: A heavy drinking owner of an Irish sports bar is the subject of a hostile takeover… by his co-owners!

videos.title: Critters and Quitters
videos.overview: KC's Neighborhood Bar & Grill is a rowdy members- only bar in Kansas whose profits have been going up in smoke thanks to the over-generous retired manager, lack of hygiene and an infestation of raccoons.

videos.title: Punch Drunk & Trailer Trashed
videos.overview: A dysfunctional family’s feuding pushes Jon Taffer to the limit. Will their outrageous antics force Jon into an extreme decision?

videos.title: Scoreboard To Death
videos.overview: Wrangling with an incompetent owner and under trained staff; actress Maria Menounos guest stars.

videos.title: Grow Some Meatballs!
videos.overview: Issues at a family-run bar include a forceful patriarch and an impending disaster in the kitchen.

videos.title: Taxed Out in Texas
videos.overview: Jon visits a struggling biker bar owned by a former tax accountant.

videos.title: When Life Doesn't Hand You Lemons
videos.overview: Too busy canoodling to notice his staff is sinking, a manager treats his bar like a romantic playground, forcing Taffer to demand inside help from the bartenders.

videos.title: I Smell A Rat
videos.overview: Oasis Hookah bar in Omaha, NE is in dire straits. They serve toxic drinks and have terrible service. To top is all off, there's a dead rat somewhere in the building, but nobody knows where.

videos.title: Scary Mary's
videos.overview: The owner of a struggling Texas dive crosses the line with one of Taffer’s experts.

videos.title: Muscle Madness
videos.overview: Two muscle-bound meatheads can't see pec-to-pec on how to run their Houston bar. Now, their tempers and testosterone threaten to tear their friendship apart.

videos.title: Bug Bite
videos.overview: Thanks to an ill-advised promotion and sloppy maintenance, a nightclub is overrun by mosquitos, fruit flies and unruly minors.

videos.title: Thugs with Mugs
videos.overview: Undisputed Sports Bar & Grill, Yonkers, NY. Rowdy customers at a New York sports bar attack Taffer's crew when they discover they are being served cheap booze at premium prices, prompting Jon to teach the importance of serving quality drinks and maintaining crowd control.

videos.title: Schmuck Dynasty
videos.overview: Rhythm & Brews, Staten Island, NY. A Staten Island bar that is overrun by customers who are cooking their own food and getting their drinks, due to the employees poor work ethic and the owner's hands off approach in running the bar. Jon must re-ignite the owner's fire and teach the staff why they need to do their own work.

videos.title: El Moronte!!
videos.overview:
Laguna Lounge

Jersey City, NJ

A passionate Puerto Rican bar owner berates his staff and sons as the bar sinks further into debt. Can Taffer deflate the owner's ego in order to save his bar?

videos.title: Anything You Can Yell, I Can Yell Louder
videos.overview:
Jack's Ale House

Sunnyside, NY

Three loud-mouthed firefighting brothers struggle to keep their Queens bar afloat. Can Taffer calm the sparks before this family implodes?

videos.title: To Protect And (Over) Serve
videos.overview:
Lickety Split

Philadelphia, PA

A former Philly detective-turned-bar owner hits the bottle hard after years of dark days on the force when Jon Taffer shows up to straighten him out.

videos.title: A Dash of Bitters
videos.overview:
Plush

Glenside, PA

A rescue turns testy when Taffer enlists the help of the bar owner's ex-wife and former manager.

videos.title: Swinging from the Rafters
videos.overview:
Dirty Rooster

Antioch, IL

An outrageous lakeside bar owner spends more time swinging from the rafters than managing his bar, causing Taffer to abandon ship until the owner can face reality.

videos.title: Spoiled Brat Party
videos.overview:
Y-Not III

Milwaukee, WI

A third generation Milwaukee bar owner puts his father’s legacy on the line by living off his family instead of trying to cut his own piece of the pie.

videos.title: Irish Eyes Aren't Smiling
videos.overview:
Packey's Pub

Milwaukee, WI

The American dream becomes a hard reality for this Irish bar owner after Taffer discovers he withheld employee paychecks to keep the business afloat.

videos.title: Second Base, Third Strike
videos.overview:
Second Base

Orange, CA

In a first-ever re-rescue, Jon Taffer returns to Second Base Bar & Grill to find a disengaged owner who has let the bar deteriorate. Will Jon save this bar once again?

videos.title: Crayons & Anger Lines
videos.overview:
Underground Wonder Bar

Chicago, IL

A hippy-dippy live music bar owner is more concerned with the spirit of wonderment than appealing to her trendy Chicago community, causing Taffer to enforce some tough love.

videos.title: Beach Rats
videos.overview:
Toucans Oceanside Bar & Grill

Hollywood, FL

This failing beachfront bar is shut down after rodents invade the kitchen, but Taffer is brought to tears upon discovering what the owners have endured.

videos.title: All Twerk & No Pay
videos.overview:
Heat Restaurant & Lounge

Hollywood, FL

Too busy dancing on the bar top to pour drinks, these out-of-control bartenders are in for a shock when Jon Taffer puts an end to the party.

videos.title: Bromancing the Stone
videos.overview:
Sandbar Sports Grill

Coconut Grove, FL

Jon Taffer has his hands full with the owner of an outdated college sports bar who is more interested in managing his fantasy football team than running a business.

videos.title: Storming the Castle
videos.overview:
Friar Tucks

Pomona, CA

Jon Taffer arrives at this castle-shaped bar to a surly owner with anger management issues whose attitude has pushed his staff to their breaking points.

videos.title: Lagers and Liars
videos.overview:
The Los Angeles Brewing Company

Los Angeles, CA

Celebrity guest Maria Menounos joins Jon Taffer at this Los Angeles beer bar where a million dollar debt and decision to keep or sell the business has triggered a family divide.

videos.title: Loose Lips Loose Tips
videos.overview:
The Holding Company

San Francisco, CA

Four bickering Irish sisters talk themselves in circles as their San Francisco bar takes a nosedive. Can Jon Taffer turn their luck around before they miss the boat on their American dream?

videos.title: Back to the Bar: Hot-Headed Owners
videos.overview: Jon revisits Solids & Stripes, Pat's Cocktails, MoonRunners Saloon and Corporate Bar & Grill to see if the hotheaded owners of these once-failing bars are keeping their cools.

videos.title: Mandala Down
videos.overview: Mandala Lounge in San Mateo, California

videos.title: Sticky Situation
videos.overview: A family-owned bar is put at risk when a son's excessive drinking and poor management choices begin to attract X-rated clientele.

videos.title: Take Me Out of the Bar Game
videos.overview: Jon is called in to help a retired baseball player turned bar owner who struck out when he hired a boozy staff content to waste the bar's profits.

videos.title: Emergency Exit
videos.overview: Before he can save their failing bar, Jon must navigate the turbulent business partnership between an ex-pilot and his ex-girlfriend

videos.title: It's Always Sunny in Portland
videos.overview: Jon tries to help the owner of a failing Portland, Oregon, bar cool the temper of his stubborn chef and his overbearing stepdaughter turned business partner.

videos.title: Brokedown Palace
videos.overview: Taffer is assisted by Alexander Siddig and Iddo Goldbert, the stars of TUT, to help him rescue a Moroccan bar with an identity crisis.

videos.title: Ants with Wings, Bro!
videos.overview: Jon tries to motivate the inattentive owner of a failing Portland, Oregon, music venue plagued by mismanagement and an ant infestation.

videos.title: Back to the Bar: Stubborn Owners
videos.overview: Jon checks in on some of the most stubborn owners he's ever worked with, including the owner of O Face, where Jon previously walked out without completing the rescue.

videos.title: Put a Cork in It
videos.overview: The eccentric owner of Brix Wine Bar is too busy being the life of the party to notice his business is withering on the vine.

videos.title: Too Many Managers, Not Enough Man
videos.overview: Jon is tasked with rescuing a Chicago sports bar that's heavy on managers and light on respect for the owner.

videos.title: Jon Ain't Afraid of No Ghost
videos.overview: A bar owner takes a less active role in his business after becoming convinced his bar is haunted.

videos.title: Back to the Bar: Delusional Owners
videos.overview: Jon checks in on four previously rescued bars, including Dimples and 22 Klicks, to see if the owners have a better grasp of the reality of their businesses.

videos.title: Till Debt Do Us Part
videos.overview: A womanizing owner will lose his run-down Caribbean bar, and his wife, if he can't change his toxic behavior.

videos.title: Shamrocks and Shenanigans
videos.overview: A lackadaisical owner may lose more than his Irish pub if Jon isn't able to help him take charge and end the fighting among his bartenders.

videos.title: Blowing Royal Smoke
videos.overview: The obnoxious behavior of two feuding brothers threatens to put an end to the storied legacy of Royal Oaks, the oldest bar and barbecue joint in Youngstown, Ohio.

videos.title: Sour Lemmons and Bitter Business
videos.overview: After giving their artsy, irresponsible landlord a share of the bar, the brothers behind Martini Brothers Burger Bar are at their wits' end and ready to call Jon for help.

videos.title: Ripper's Rookie House
videos.overview: Former Judas Priest front man Tim "Ripper" Owens calls in Jon after discovering being a rock star and running a rock club are two very different skills.

videos.title: Big Sister's Watching
videos.overview: In a struggling military bar, a distrustful owner spends her time spying on her staff instead of watching the bottom line.

videos.title: Vulgar Vixens
videos.overview: Jon visits The Hooch, an X-rated bar where the foulmouthed owner wastes her husband's money and constantly berates her female staff.

videos.title: Unnecessary Toughness
videos.overview: At an Ann Arbor, MI, college alumni bar, Jon is forced to deal with a hotheaded owner whose fiery temper keeps his staff on edge and his million-dollar debt on ice.

videos.title: Boss Lady Blues
videos.overview: A former psychologist turned bar owner attempts to run a Detroit jazz club, but her interfering family and lazy staff have her seeking counseling from Jon.

videos.title: Bare Rescue
videos.overview: In a Bar Rescue first, Jon helps a failing strip club saddled with a disinterested staff, a skeevy vibe and an off-putting name: Chix on Dix.

videos.title: Back to the Bar: No Laughing Matter
videos.overview: Jon returns to see if the McGowan brothers have cooled off their fiery relationship. He also takes on an angry stand-up comedy club owner from Stand Up, Scottsdale

videos.title: Hard Heads and Softballs
videos.overview: The feud between the owners of Mac & Chester's SRO has led to a bifurcation of their business and attracted a dysfunctional, rowdy clientele.

videos.title: Dragon Lady
videos.overview: Jon is tasked with getting the apathetic owner of Van Goghz to put down her vape pen and start engaging with customers.

videos.title: Paradise Lost
videos.overview: An explosive conflict breaks out among the owners of Dale 1891 when Jon discovers one of them has been siphoning off profits.

videos.title: Back to the Bar: Meathead-to-Head
videos.overview: Jon revisits the Dirty Rooster and ruffles the feathers of its owner, then he mediates a muscle-bound dispute between rival Texas bar owners.

videos.title: Land of the Beer and Home of the Misbehaved
videos.overview: A successful St. Louis, MO, restaurateur risks everything when she decides to add a downtown sports bar to her portfolio and put her out-of-control nephew in charge.

videos.title: Getting Freaki at the Tiki
videos.overview: He's no stranger to unkempt bars, but Jon is absolutely disgusted by the rat, roach and raccoon problem inside Freaki Tiki.

videos.title: Back to the Bar: Empty Pockets
videos.overview: Jon heads back to MT Bottle to put a fork in their gravy dispute, then he finds out what the owners of Piratz have planned for the future.

videos.title: How to Train the Dragon
videos.overview: Jon must help the owner of George & Dragon come to terms with his mother's death before he drinks away all his profits and the family legacy.

videos.title: Demolition Man
videos.overview: Jon schools the clueless owner of Grinders, whose unauthorized and unsafe renovation has the city threatening to shut the place down.

videos.title: Back to the Bar: Luck of the Irish
videos.overview: Jon reveals which of his rescues has been most successful, tests the luck of Campbell's Irish Pub and revisits The Lister and its infamous "porn couch."

videos.title: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Boat
videos.overview: A former doctor decides to run The Bridge Lounge, his father's once-successful bar, but runs into trouble when the BP oil spill devastates the local customer base.

videos.title: Danny Sits on His Fanny
videos.overview: After convincing his friends to invest their life savings, the rookie bar owner of Cirivello's has turned a community staple into a money pit and now faces a hostile takeover.

videos.title: Gon in a Flash
videos.overview: The timid owner of City Bistro in St. Louis, MO, looks the other way as her raunchy bartenders flash customers to drum up business.

videos.title: Momster's Ball
videos.overview: Jon is called in to help the failing owner of Baseline Sports Bar, whose sexually exploitive spaghetti wrestling events have driven away female customers.

videos.title: Drunk on Punk
videos.overview: Jon has a hard time getting through to the owner of the Black Light District, who's convinced fixing up his rancid dive would be a betrayal of his punk rock credo.

videos.title: Raising Arizona
videos.overview: The owner of The Gallopin' Goose ruined his marriage and his bar's reputation when he had an illicit affair that resulted in a child.

videos.title: The Perks of Being a Wallpaper
videos.overview: A classic dive bar with mob ties in Las Vegas is about to close its doors because of an owner who's busy being a nice guy rather than a wise guy.

videos.title: Wheels of Misfortune
videos.overview: In a desert town, Taffer collides with the owner of a bar in a roller rink, a local landmark close to closing for good.

videos.title: Whipped Into Shape
videos.overview: After gambling his life savings on a run down Las Vegas bar, a desperate owner tries out a fetish night to whip up new business.

videos.title: Antisocial Media
videos.overview: Taffer helps an owner whose social media mishaps have made him public enemy number one.

videos.title: How to Train Your Goldfish
videos.overview: Nasty nachos & goldfish races are on the menu at this sports pub. But in a Bar Rescue first, a staffing crisis hits before the stress test, leaving the owners without any employees. Can Taffer right the ship before it drowns?

videos.title: Win, Lose or Brawl
videos.overview: Taffer must fix an out-of-control staff and the owner’s freeloading friends. But a violent physical fight threatens this sports bar’s rescue potential.

videos.title: Listen Y'all It's Sabotage
videos.overview: New bar owners accuse their manager (and the bar's former owner) of sabotaging their business to try to steal it back. With no clear proof, Jon uses a stress test to determine who's right and who's wrong.

videos.title: Gettin' Jigger With It
videos.overview: A historical landmark bar, divided in profits and responsibility, pits brother and sister against one another.

videos.title: Chase Lounge
videos.overview: A lazy step-son fails to step into his new role as bar manager. And while his father can sell a car, it doesn't mean he can run a bar.

videos.title: Zero Dark Drunky
videos.overview: A military hero on the verge of being redeployed needs a rescue of his own, before he drinks away his profits and angers his bartender girlfriend past the point of no return.

videos.title: Ice, Mice, Baby
videos.overview: A spoiled owner is gifted a nightclub by his father. Can Taffer save this mice-infested tourist bar before the owner gives away all his profits?

videos.title: Punk as a Drunk
videos.overview: A former punk rocker hits bottom after being overwhelmed with tragedy. But his constant roughhousing with his employees draws Taffer's ire.

videos.title: Back To The Bar: Drunky Mcdrunkerton Returns
videos.overview: The gloves are off as Taffer confronts the leopard-print loving ladies of The Handlebar; Janet Jackson-playing bartender Brandon, plate-throwing Ami, and The Brixton owner Tim return.

videos.title: Don't Tell Mom the Bar is Dead
videos.overview: An abrasive owner takes advantage of his mom's generosity to take over a craft beer bar from his landlord.

videos.title: I Know What You Did Last Summit
videos.overview: An absentee owner puts his marriage on the line by drinking away his financial sorrows and flirting with the female clientele. Can Taffer step in to save a crumbling relationship and a failed bar?

videos.title: Struck Out at the Dugout
videos.overview: Taffer faces his most resistive owner yet after a lackluster landlord falls into the sports bar business when a previous tenant refuses to pay rent of this World Series winning Chicago Cub's hangout.

videos.title: Back to the Bar: Brick & Barley Above Water
videos.overview: Taffer confronts AJ from Brick & Barley over her blistering attitude and the civil strife with her daughters over the bar's uniforms while a combative owner comes clean about the failure of his bar after the rescue.

videos.title: All Twerk and No Pay Makes Taffer Shut It Down
videos.overview: An owner twerks her way to tears when her bar gets out of step

videos.title: Bar Over Troubled Water

videos.title: Slotzy's Last Shotzy
videos.overview: Jon Taffer travels to Worden, IL to rescue a bar for an owner who inherited the business from his father but relies on an untrained manager to secure its future success.

videos.title: Sitting Down on the Job
videos.overview: In Ashland City, TN, Jon Taffer confronts a defiant owner who literally sits on a stool while his family's bar crumbles around him. With the business on the brink, Taffer must inspire this idle owner to stand up and fight.

videos.title: One Man Brand
videos.overview: Jon Taffer travels to Marietta, Georgia, to confront a dire situation. He must rescue a failing bar from an owner who stubbornly clings to the misguided belief that his own personal brand alone possesses the power to reverse its fortune.

videos.title: When Dreams Hit the Sidewalk
videos.overview: In Orlando, Florida, Jon Taffer is on a mission to save a struggling bar. Despite the owner's genuine passion and dedication, the establishment is failing due to a fundamentally flawed and misguided concept that was doomed from its very inception

videos.title: Alley Cat-astrophe
videos.overview: Jon Taffer travels to Bowling Green, Kentucky, to revitalize a struggling bar plagued by a management crisis, as two bartenders contend for a leadership role after the current manager proves ineffectual in overseeing the bar's operations.

videos.title: A Palette of Problems
videos.overview: A married couple's dream of a successful art-themed bar is in jeopardy, so Jon Taffer steps in to help in Douglasville, Georgia. Their passion for art is undeniable, but their lack of business acumen is leading to failure.

videos.title: Don't Leave it to Happenchance
videos.overview: Jon Taffer heads to Nolensville, Tennessee, to help a couple whose ambitious plans for an upscale wine bar have completely backfired, leaving their business on the brink of failure and their dreams shattered.

videos.title: Flush the Slush
videos.overview: Jon Taffer heads to Melbourne, Florida to help rescue a former radio entrepreneur turned bar owner who has suffered personal losses that have caused his business to suffer.

videos.title: Crust Issues
videos.overview: In Kirkwood, Georgia, a pizza place with a confused identity is failing under its owner's constant micromanagement. Jon Taffer steps in to rescue the business, overhaul its concept, and confront the owner's destructive leadership style.

videos.title: 615 Reasons to Fail
videos.overview: In Murfreesboro, Tennessee, Jon Taffer must save a bar from failure. The problem stems from the owner's choice to have her boyfriend, a man with absolutely no professional skills or prior experience, manage the entire business operation.

videos.title: Broken Chains of Command
videos.overview: Jon Taffer heads to DeBary, Florida to rescue a VFW post that is losing members and suffering a financial crisis due to confusion surrounding the leadership of the bar. He must not only rescue the post but also help them establish proper management.

videos.title: Hair of the Big Dog
videos.overview: Jon Taffer heads to Mt. Dora, Florida to rescue a failing bar where an owner struggles to run her business alone after the tragic passing of her partner. While her daughter and son-in-law offer to help, she is unwilling to accept their ideas.

videos.title: Havana Rough Time
videos.overview: Jon Taffer faces a unique challenge in Powder Springs, Georgia: a Cuban-themed cigar bar rendered illegal by a city-wide smoking ban. The owners are now in deep debt and weeks from closing.
